[EN] Mission Orders

The mekonari and their allies foment rebellion in Nightwood.

Drive out the {@LinkCreature:56#11#runekeeper deceivers}, {@LinkCreature:56#13#spectral legates}, and mekonari {@LinkCreature:56#15#occultists}, {@LinkCreature:56#57#hunters}, and {@LinkCreature:56#58#ebonweavers}.

Report to Emya in Dragonfall when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Los mekonari y sus aliados fomentan la rebelión en Nightwood.

Expulsa a los {@LinkCreature:56#11#runekeeper deceivers}, {@LinkCreature:56#13#spectral legates} y a los {@LinkCreature:56#15#occultists}, {@LinkCreature:56#57#hunters} y {@LinkCreature:56#58#ebonweavers} mekonari.

Reportate con Emya en Dragonfall cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
